lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Hello! I am Tilly. I love <color=red>stories</color>.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Listen to my story. Then I will ask you four questions. Get them right and I will give the library four new <color=red>books</color>!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Pip is a little <color=red>fox</color>. Pip has a red hat.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: One night, Pip sees a big, bright <color=red>moon</color>. "I want the moon!" says Pip.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Pip climbs a tall <color=red>hill</color>. But the moon is still far away.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Then Pip sees the moon in a <color=red>pond</color>. Pip smiles and goes home.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about the start of the story!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about what Pip says!
lines.correctText: That is right! Pip wants the moon.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 4: Where does Pip see the moon at the end?
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about the end of the story!
lines.correctText: Yes! The moon is in the pond.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Four out of four! You are a super <color=red>reader</color>. The library has four new books!

afterLines.speaker: Tilly
afterLines.text: Thank you for listening to my story. Go and see the new <color=red>books</color> in the library!
